record.site_desc: PAS is located on a private farm near the city of Pedras Altas in Rio Grande do Sul State, Brazil, withinof Pampa Biome, with a great diversity of grass species. There is no evidence that the area was used for another type of management than livestock. The soil consists of Neosols and Cambisols, with rocky outcrops. The soil textural characteristics correspond to a shallow sandy-loam soil. The climate belongs to the Cfa classification.

grp_igbp.igbp_comment: The phytophysiognomy of the PAS has double extract with predominance of creeping species, mainly stoloniferous and rhizomatous species, and also includes Axonopus affinis, Paspalum notatum, Aeristida laevis, and Iriantus angustifolium
